info.name: EODHD Financial Data Calendar Technical API
Retrieve technical indicator data for a specified symbol.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Symbol in the format {SYMBOL_NAME}.{EXCHANGE_ID}, e.g., AAPL.US for Apple Inc.

params.name: function
params.description: The function to calculate the technical indicator (e.g., 'sma' for Simple Moving Average).

params.name: period
params.description: Number of data points used to calculate the indicator. Default is 50.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for data retrieval in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for data retrieval in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order of dates: 'a' for ascending, 'd' for descending. Default is ascending.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Output format, either 'json' or 'csv'. Default is 'json'.

params.name: splitadjusted_only
params.description: For select functions, adjust data only for splits by setting to '1'. Default is '0'.

params.name: filter
params.description: Retrieve only the last value by specifying 'last_ema' or 'last_volume' as the filter.

items.docs: Fetches technical indicator data, such as moving averages and other analytics, based on specified parameters.
